reasons.plausibility: Replacing Ta with Nb to reduce density while maintaining strength in a high-entropy alloy is scientifically sound, given their similar refractory character, although some uncertainties about the exact mechanical trade-offs remain.
reasons.testability: A direct, head-to-head test of the original vs. Nb-substituted alloy under identical casting and testing conditions is clearly described and would unambiguously confirm or refute the hypothesis based on mechanical performance and phase stability measurements.
reasons.usefulness: This proposal directly addresses a recognized challenge—reducing density without sacrificing strength—offering a concrete approach that could guide further research on high-temperature high-entropy alloys.
